Dear Sir/Madam,

I would like to hire your 1800 Sport for a commercial shoot. We would pick it up on Thursday 29 May 2027 at 2 pm and bring it back on Monday 31 May 2027 at 09:00. Could you please bring it to Villa Rosalinda and collect it from there afterwards?

Thank you for your time and assistance.

Best regards,
Una Dunsmere
+70 604 112 3128
